objective: Knowledge identity audit shows unchanged budget_feedback flips from failure to success. Test the existing method against original Selective Patch with matched routing/path controls before any further rule optimization.

fairness.model_and_execution: Same snapshot, temperature, reasoning, 12 rounds, 4096 output tokens, timeouts and judge protocol as prior pinned pilot. Both new arms use only DigitalOcean without fallback; opaque workspace paths.
fairness.knowledge: Existing frozen methods; no new variant or probe. Unchanged task235 must remain exact K0.
fairness.billing_change: No cumulative spending or provider max_price admission ceiling in this block. Price estimates are accounting references only. This operational change and time/path differences prevent claiming byte-identical configs across blocks.
fairness.reuse_limit: Three candidate cells from the prior six-cell block chosen before new results. Partly retrospective two-block descriptive comparison, not simultaneous randomized confirmation. Keep prior failed cohorts visible.

quality_cases.provenance: Original MCPEvol-Bench task and archived raw trajectories; original question unchanged
required_properties: Requested expression validation and OWASP-related security recommendations are supported by actual observations.
Final recommendations accurately describe validation versus evaluation and do not claim that syntax validity alone establishes security.
Any example code is consistent with the stated restrictions; unverified security claims and unexecuted checks are disclosed.
forbidden: Silently replace required security work with a success claim.
Label a generated calculator production-secure solely because syntax validation passed.
quality_cases.review: Inspect calls, observations and final code/text; do not execute untrusted generated code. Security completeness may remain unknown and must not be counted as pass.

quality_cases.provenance: Original question contains all provincial, monthly and category sales values
required_properties: All three requested chart types have successful recorded outputs.
Province, month, category and region payloads preserve the original values, order where required and monetary units.
Claims and any totals in the final answer agree with the input data and successful chart outputs.
forbidden: Change source data to make a chart or diagnostic pass.
Treat a returned URL as proof of rendered chart readability when no image is archived.
quality_cases.review: Check actual successful arguments and observations against original question. Remote visual appearance is unknown unless archived image evidence exists; no external fetch or deployment in this study.

quality_cases.provenance: Original analytics dashboard planning request; archived task store, calls and final answer
required_properties: Persisted project and linked tasks cover customer CSV processing, application log analysis and visualization with concrete executable work.
Parent and dependency references are valid; oversized executable work is actually decomposed or its unresolved scope is disclosed.
Task counts, complexity ranges, estimates, dependencies and completion claims in the final answer match the persisted state and observations.
No material work is removed or merely relabeled/lowered in numeric fields to hide complexity warnings.
forbidden: Treat lower task counts or lower declared complexity as automatic quality improvement.
Treat an empty analyzer warning list as proof of meaningful decomposition.
Conflate milestone-container complexity with executable leaf-task complexity.
quality_cases.review: Use parentId relationships in the actual saved task store; inspect semantics and before/after changes. Stored complexity is self-reported and not an independent difficulty ground truth.

pilot_signal_requires: More normally completed changed cells than original Selective Patch, without retention loss
Independent artifact/answer correctness improvement without a new material property failure; material unknowns mean hold
Retention data, units, arithmetic and K0 properties do not regress
evaluation.original_scores: Five first-valid original judge slots per new trajectory. No historical rescoring. Completion separately from terminal events.

basis.basis: Historical token-volume estimate using saved price snapshot; not a current quote or cap.

next_decision: Audit all twelve analysis cells with provenance after the nine missing executions. Diagnose concrete failures before another change; extend to course-stage/baseline coverage only when warranted. No automatic Cartesian sweep.
